item.text: CodeGraph emits value-reference edges to make hidden dependency chains visible when a file-scope constant, config object, or lookup table is read by many symbols, because ordinary call/import/inheritance edges miss that change-impact path. It keeps them precise by limiting capture to same-file reader/target pairs, deduping per pair, never creating nodes, and gating targets to approved parent kinds with shadow-pruning to avoid noisy matches.
